title: A320 Solar Radiation Single-Event Effect
deliveries_context: About 6,000 aircraft, fewer than 100 remaining on 1 Dec 2025.

sources.title: EASA Emergency Airworthiness Directive
sources.fact_referenced: Emergency AD issued 28 Nov 2025 for ~6,000 aircraft; effective date to be confirmed from AD document.

sources.title: Airbus Alert Notification to Operators
sources.fact_referenced: Airbus alert issued 28 Nov 2025; stated intense solar radiation may corrupt data critical to flight controls; <100 remaining on 1 Dec 2025.

dated_events.label: Incident Event
dated_events.description: Data corruption event critical to flight controls occurs at cruise altitude. Airbus stated intense solar radiation may corrupt data; independent experts questioned whether radiation level was unusual. Axis B is exposure context, not a cause.

dated_events.label: Airbus Alert & EASA Emergency AD Issued
dated_events.description: Airbus alert and EASA emergency directive issued 28 Nov 2025 (effective date to be confirmed from the AD document).

dated_events.label: Rectification Progress
dated_events.description: Fewer than 100 aircraft remaining out of ~6,000 affected.

title: A320 Fuselage Panels Production Discrepancy
deliveries_context: 2025 delivery target cut 820 to 790 on 3 Dec 2025.

sources.title: EASA Proposed Airworthiness Directive (PAD)
sources.fact_referenced: EASA PROPOSED directive published 17 Dec 2025 (177 in service, 451 in production); later final directive to be confirmed.

sources.title: Airbus Public Statement on Fuselage Panels
sources.fact_referenced: Airbus public statement 2 Dec 2025 confirming 628 in scope; 2025 delivery target cut 820 to 790 on 3 Dec 2025.

sources.title: Reuters Industrial Investigation
sources.fact_referenced: Reuters breakdown: 168 in service, 245 on assembly lines (about 100 due for delivery in 2025), 215 in earlier production.

dated_events.label: Airbus Public Statement
dated_events.description: Airbus public statement confirming 628 aircraft in scope for fuselage panel discrepancy.

dated_events.label: Delivery Target Cut
dated_events.description: Airbus officially cuts 2025 delivery target from 820 to 790 aircraft.

dated_events.label: EASA PROPOSED Directive Published
dated_events.description: EASA publishes PROPOSED directive for 628 aircraft (177 in service, 451 in production); later final directive to be confirmed.

fleet_breakdowns.name: EASA Proposed Directive (17 Dec 2025)
fleet_breakdowns.notes: Official EASA Proposed Directive regulatory scope: 177 in service, 451 in production.

fleet_breakdowns.name: Reuters Sourced Breakdown
fleet_breakdowns.notes: 168 in service, 245 on assembly lines (about 100 due for delivery in 2025), 215 in earlier production.

title: A330neo Stray Assembly Tool Inspection
deliveries_context: Zero deliveries in June and July 2026; 3, 2, 4 in March, April, May; one on 11 Aug 2026; number of aircraft inspected not disclosed; policy to the regulator due mid-November 2026.
in_service_scope_notes: Reports conflict: one says no retroactive fix is required for in-service aircraft, another says inspections are recommended for aircraft delivered from early 2021 to end of May 2026, with final requirements under discussion with the regulator. Needs verification.

sources.title: Airbus Monthly Orders & Deliveries Files (2026)
sources.fact_referenced: Official deliveries: March (3), April (2), May (4); June (0), July (0); 11 Aug 2026 (1).

sources.title: Regulator Oversight Discussion
sources.fact_referenced: Inspection policy to the regulator due mid-November 2026; in-service requirements under discussion.

dated_events.label: Regulator Policy Filing Milestone
dated_events.description: Inspection policy to the regulator due mid-November 2026.
